name: B10-0283/2025 (The Left) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Georgia's government to respect free speech, press freedom and the right to protest. It condemns the arrest of journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, who faces up to seven years in prison on a charge of assaulting a police officer, and calls for her release. It also asks for a constructive dialogue between Georgia and the European Union.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- It concerns Georgia's government, its journalists, and Mzia Amaglobeli personally.
- The resolution is sent to the European Union's institutions, member states, the United Nations and Georgia's leaders.
